title: J. M. Mckenney Middle School counts 280 white students in 2025-26 enrollment
text:
J. M. Mckenney Middle School counted 280 white students among its enrollment for the 2025-26 school year, representing a 0.7% increase over the prior year, data from the New York State Education Department showed.
According to the report, the total enrollment at J. M. Mckenney Middle School reached 304 students in the 2025-26 school year. White students accounted for 92.1% of the student population, making them the largest ethnic group at the school.
The school operates under Canton Central School District, which is based in Canton.
F. S. Banford Elementary School, one of three schools in the district, recorded the most white students during that time, with 397 enrolled.
Based on analysis by World Population Review, New York’s public education system was ranked second in the nation overall but came in 31st for K-12 performance.
